pages.title: Empirical Notes I
pages.text: A sheaf of first-hand observations from the hardest experiments of my early work: time's arrow, a kugelblitz forming, gravitons, a stellar core, a monopole. The handwriting gets worse as the experiments get stranger. Every page smells faintly of ozone.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)When I first tried to teach a machine to study, I realised my raw notes were scattered across every lab. Pressing an arrow of time shard, a kugelblitz seed, a magnetic monopole and their kin into the Femtoscale line made them into a record a machine could read.
